initContainers.name: wait-for-n8n
command:
until wget -q -O /dev/null \
  http://n8n:5678/healthz; do
  echo "Waiting for n8n..."
  sleep 5
done
echo "n8n is ready."

initContainers.name: wait-for-postgres
command:
until psql \
  -h postgres \
  -p 5432 \
  -U "$PGUSER" \
  -d "$PGDATABASE" \
  -tAc "SELECT 1" | grep -qx 1; do
  echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
  sleep 5
done
echo "PostgreSQL is ready."
